title: The Binder-DeMarco-Dupont Inequality
summary: In the setting of endomorphisms of $\mathbb{P}^k(\mathbb{C})$, a dimension formula for the measure of maximal entropy was conjectured by Binder and DeMarco in 2003, asserting that $$\mathrm{dim}_\mathrm{Hausdorff}(\mu)=\log d\sum_{i=1}^k \frac{1}{\chi_i},$$ where $d$ is the degree of the (non-invertible) endomorphism and $\chi_i$'s are the Lyapunov exponents with multiplicity. Indeed, this is well-defined as all Lyapunov exponents are known to be positive due to Briend and Duval.
